meta.title: Stranded in Prehistory
meta.subtitle: 🦖 A time experiment goes wrong, and now you're trapped in the age of dinosaurs.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: 🔬 The Experiment
scenes.narrative:
You stand inside a research lab staring at a glowing time device.

⚡ The test was supposed to be controlled.

Instead, the machine overloads.

A blinding flash fills the room.

Then silence.

You wake up in a dense jungle.

🦖 Something massive roars in the distance.

scenes.title: 🌳 The Jungle
scenes.narrative:
The air is hot and humid.

🌿 Giant plants tower around you.

Nearby footprints are larger than your entire body.

You are definitely not in your own time anymore.

scenes.title: 😨 Panic
scenes.narrative:
You sprint through the jungle blindly.

🌿 Branches snap around you.

The ground begins to shake.

Something huge is chasing you.

scenes.title: 🌳 Up High
scenes.narrative:
You scramble up a tree just in time.

🦖 A massive T-Rex stomps beneath you, sniffing the air.

After several tense moments, it finally wanders away.

You survived… barely.

scenes.title: 🦖 The Predator
scenes.narrative:
You follow the massive footprints through the jungle.

Then you see it.

🦖 A T-Rex feeds on something in a clearing ahead.

It hasn't noticed you yet.

scenes.title: 🏔 Cliffside
scenes.narrative:
You climb onto a rocky cliff overlooking the jungle.

🦕 Herds of dinosaurs roam across the land below.

Far in the distance, you spot something metallic.

Part of your machine survived the jump through time.

scenes.title: 🦕 The Herd
scenes.narrative:
A herd of enormous herbivores moves peacefully across the valley.

🌎 The sight is breathtaking.

Suddenly, something startles them.

The ground begins to shake violently.

scenes.title: 📡 Hidden Tech
scenes.narrative:
Hidden beneath vines and dirt is a glowing piece of metal.

⚡ It's part of your time device.

Somehow… it's still barely active.

scenes.title: ⚙️ Crash Site
scenes.narrative:
You discover the shattered remains of your machine.

💡 Several pieces still glow faintly.

This may be your only chance to return home.

scenes.title: 🏕 Survival
scenes.narrative:
You gather sticks, stones, and anything useful.

💧 Fresh water nearby gives you hope.

But strange calls echo through the jungle as night approaches.

scenes.title: ⚡ Final Choice
scenes.narrative:
After hours of work, the damaged device sparks back to life.

⚡ Energy crackles through the machine.

You finally have a choice.

Go home… or stay in the past forever.

scenes.title: ☠️ Caught
scenes.narrative:
You run through the jungle as fast as you can.

But the predator is faster.

🦖 Heavy footsteps thunder behind you.

Then everything goes dark.

scenes.title: 🦕 Trampled
scenes.narrative:
The herd panics and charges across the valley.

🌎 The earth shakes beneath thousands of pounding feet.

There is nowhere to escape.

scenes.title: 🏕 New Life
scenes.narrative:
You build a shelter deep within the prehistoric jungle.

Days slowly become months.

🌿 You learn the land, the creatures, and the dangers of this ancient world.

You are no longer just surviving here.

You belong here now.

scenes.title: 🌌 Back Home
scenes.narrative:
The repaired device activates.

⚡ Time bends around you.

Moments later, you collapse back inside your laboratory.

Everything appears normal.

But somewhere in the distant past… dinosaurs still roam.

scenes.title: 📚 The Scientist
scenes.narrative:
You choose to remain in the prehistoric world.

🦖 Day after day, you study creatures no human was ever meant to see.

Your discoveries could rewrite history itself.

If you ever make it home.

scenes.title: 🌌 Time Collapse
scenes.narrative:
You overload the machine beyond its limits.

⚡ Reality fractures around you.

Past, present, and future collide into one endless moment.

You exist everywhere… and nowhere at all.
